papers.title: Atrophy-related inflammation CSF markers predict clinical progression in genetic frontotemporal dementia
papers.summary:
-  We classified 9 files: 2 data, 7 code.
-  We found 2 tabular data files and extracted 38 columns from 2 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex16). We ran automated data-quality checks on 38 columns; 1 column has at least one potential issue (1 column whose name suggests personal information). We detected demographic columns for Age, Gender.
